summary.headline: Triplicity Omens and Worldly Calamities
summary.text: Astrological predictions for Mars and the Moon in the fiery and airy triplicities, including effects of Capricorn, Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius on rulers, cities, travelers, weather, disease, warfare, and public unrest. Named regions and polities include Rome, Arabia, Persia, Babylon, Khuzestan, Ahvaz, Arab Iraq, and Rabi'ah.
